comment: explode.c explosionmask() AD_DISN for the hero from a WAND_CLASS explosion: a Samurai in debug mode wishes for a wand of death, polymorphs into a human zombie (nonliving), and applies the wand to break it. do_break_wand() -> broken_wand_explode() -> explode(-WAN_DEATH, WAND_CLASS) makes a 'death field' (AD_DISN); explosionmask() takes the WAND_CLASS arm, nonliving(youmonst.data) holds, and it returns EXPL_HERO, so the hero gets the shield effect instead of the damage. Seed, date, role and inputs chosen independently.
